services.name: field trips
services.desc: Looking to educate, inspire AND have fun with your students? Not only do our programs support Colorado Academic Standards and 21st Century Skills, they are sure to entertain. Listed costs are for programs held within the seven-county metro area. Financial aid is available to Title I schools and to groups where 50% or more of the student population is eligible for the Federal Free & Reduced Lunch (FRL) program. Not sure what your school’s FRL percentage is? You can look it up here. Financial aid is available on a first-come, first-served basis and must be requested at the time you make your reservation. services.name: Venue Rentals
services.desc: The Children’s Museum of Denver at Marsico Campus is the perfect place to host your next event. Whether it’s an important business meeting, a formal dinner illuminated by the lights of downtown Denver, or a whimsical cocktail party for your closest friends, we’ve got you covered. Enjoy access to all of our world-class exhibits and a private room with stunning views of the Platte River and downtown Denver. We have packages to fit parties of all sizes! Create unforgettable memories with world-class exhibits, sophisticated spaces and beautiful views. Host your wedding reception, cocktail party or corporate banquet in our refined Skyline Gallery and enjoy incredible views of downtown Denver.

services.name: Climbing pass
services.desc: Starting September 1, Adventure Forest is open Friday - Sunday, plus September 7, September 28 and October 12. The last day to play for the season is October 31. Adventure Forest is a brilliant, BOLD, 500 ft. long adventure course and immersive art installation created by our in-house exhibits team and artist, Wes Bruce. Meet the Council of Creatures, decode a secret language and discover the story behind Adventure Forest here.
